name: Dominio de Valdepusa

known.via: English Wikipedia "Dominio de Valdepusa" (a wine place on Wikidata)

terms: A wine from a pago, a named rural site with its own soil and microclimate. All its grapes must grow there.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A Vino de Pago in Malpica de Tajo, Toledo. The category requires every grape to come from vineyards in the pago, with the wine made and bottled by their owners. Allowed grapes include Cabernet Sauvignon, Graciano, Petit Verdot and Syrah.
